method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a single triangle with the bottom base labeled 2.3 ft, the right slanted side labeled 1.9 ft, and the included angle between that base and right side labeled 25°. The text asks for the triangle's area rounded to the nearest hundredth. Use the two-sides-included-angle area formula A = (1/2)ab sin(C), substituting a = 2.3, b = 1.9, C = 25°. Compute A = (1/2)(2.3)(1.9)sin(25°) ≈ 0.92 square feet.
